# Collect non-blank rows from the range

    is_blank = True
    row_data = []
    for col_idx in range(start_col, end_col + 1):
        cell = ws.cell(row_idx, col_idx)
        cell_value = cell.value
        if cell_value is not None:
            is_blank = False
        # Store cell value and style
        row_data.append({
            'value': cell_value,
            'font': cell.font.copy() if cell.font else None,
            'fill': cell.fill.copy() if cell.fill else None,
            'border': cell.border.copy() if cell.border else None,
            'alignment': cell.alignment.copy() if cell.alignment else None,
            'number_format': cell.number_format

        cell = ws.cell(write_row, col_idx)
        cell.value = cell_data['value']
        if cell_data['font']:
            cell.font = cell_data['font']
        if cell_data['fill']:
            cell.fill = cell_data['fill']
        if cell_data['border']:
            cell.border = cell_data['border']
        if cell_data['alignment']:
            cell.alignment = cell_data['alignment']
        cell.number_format = cell_data['number_format']
    write_row += 1

# Clear the remaining rows in the range (fill with None)
for row_idx in range(write_row, end_row + 1):
    for col_idx in range(start_col, end_col + 1):
        cell = ws.cell(row_idx, col_idx)
        cell.value = None

print(f"Wrote {len(non_blank_rows)} rows starting from row {start_row}")
print(f"Cleared rows {write_row} to {end_row}")

# Save the workbook
